entities.name: PMID:27519661
observations: Cohort study in dentofacial-deformity patients reported ESR1 rs1643821 AA as a risk factor for dysfunctional worsening after orthognathic surgery; ENPP1 rs858339 TT protective against TMD, while AT was a risk factor.

entities.name: PMID:29103441
observations: In 174 patients with dentofacial deformity, ENPP1 rs858339 was associated with prevalent TMD diagnoses across asymmetry groups; asymmetric patients had higher preoperative JPF scores, and most TMD improved after treatment at one year.

entities.name: ENPP1
observations: The 2016 cohort associated rs858339 TT with lower TMD risk and AT with higher TMD risk among patients with dentofacial deformities; 2017 work linked rs858339 with TMD diagnoses in craniofacial asymmetry subgroups.

entities.name: ESR1
observations: The 2016 cohort reported rs1643821 AA as a risk factor for dysfunctional worsening after orthognathic surgery; a 2017 study associated other ESR1 SNPs with asymmetry subtypes/principal components.

entities.name: Temporomandibular disorders
observations: In dentofacial deformity cohorts, ENPP1 and ESR1 genotypes have been reported as candidate associations with TMD susceptibility/severity and postoperative symptoms; evidence is observational and does not establish causality or clinical prediction.
